notes: The language designated for validation against speechocean762 (250 non-native speakers, all Mandarin L1). Validated against speechocean762 (500 test-split utterances, base.en, CPU): 2.2% false-flag reduction (14 of 645) at 97.5% retention (233 of 239); see eval/results.json; Mandarin-L1 speakers only. Mandarin disallows most final consonants and lacks the English dental fricatives.
sources: Swan & Smith, Learner English: A Teacher's Guide to Interference and Other Problems, Cambridge — Chinese chapter
